from shop.cart import discount, shipping_fee
from shop.money import round_half


# flowguard: sensor FREE_SHIPPING
def checkout_free_shipping(subtotal: int) -> bool:
    return subtotal > 50


def total(lines, member, express):
    subtotal = sum(price * qty for price, qty in lines)
    tax_tenths = subtotal * 19 // 10
    return subtotal - discount(subtotal, member) + shipping_fee(subtotal, express) + round_half(tax_tenths)
